title: ZeroTurn report
description: Output of zeroturn report <window> --json. Counts are events ZeroTurn observed locally, never a token or cost breakdown.

peakContextPercent.description: Absent when no session reported a context percentage.

provenance.const: Based only on events observed locally by ZeroTurn on this machine.

credentialWarnings.description: How many times the credential guard asked or denied before a file was read.

assessment.description: Whether recorded validation evidence still covers the code that is in the repository now. Absent from a report covering the machine, because evidence belongs to one repository. Not affected by the report window: this is the latest evidence there is, not a count of what happened inside a span.

state.description: The single word for a person. A reader deciding what to do should use result and current instead, which never lose the original outcome.

result.description: What the recorded run concluded. A failed run that has since gone stale still reports failed here.

current.description: Whether the repository still matches the state the run was made against.

changed.description: Which inputs differ from the recorded ones. Empty when the evidence is current.

reason.description: A whole sentence saying what the state means and what to do about it.

evidence.description: The record this assessment is about, as described by evidence.schema.json. Absent when no validation has been recorded.
